fields.hero_title: A real CMS runtime before pixel confidence
fields.hero_body: Long-copy mutation for clipping and responsive growth.

cards.title: Observe the reference — editor supplied title that is intentionally much longer than the baseline composition
cards.body: Read structure, responsive evidence, assets, and interaction before deciding implementation architecture. This paragraph intentionally continues with substantially more editorial copy so the runtime can prove that readable text grows instead of clipping or escaping its card container across desktop, tablet, and mobile widths. The content is not pixel-diffed against Figma because this state does not exist in the reference, and the browser robustness result must remain separate from visual-fidelity scoring.
